meta.title: Implement `olive optimize` CLI command with comprehensive pass scheduling
meta.body_summary: Implement new `olive optimize` CLI command with a comprehensive pass scheduling system to automate model optimization for various execution providers, precisions, and model types.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot built a large-scale CLI feature with iterative maintainer guidance; approved but closed without merge, likely not fully production-ready.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: Large change (3344 lines) for a new feature; despite maintainer requests and eventual approvals, the PR was closed without merge, possibly because the feature is not fully production-ready or requires more validation.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainers extensively requested feature additions (--save_config_file, --block_size, --modality, --qnn_env_path, API documentation, test naming, etc.) and the agent responded with commits, but the PR was closed without merge despite final approvals.
review_details.performance_claim: The command provides a comprehensive optimization workflow with intelligent pass scheduling based on user-specified parameters.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Large-scale feature implementation with complex pass scheduling for multiple hardware backends; agent handled iterative feature requests but the PR remained open/unmerged despite approvals, indicating that production readiness may require further maintainer review or testing.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainers provided specific code refactoring suggestions, feature addition requests, and test improvements via inline comments.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body includes manual test instructions (cluster setup, SQL commands) but no performance benchmarks or before/after measurements.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no regressions addressed in review.

core_change_summary.description: Introduced new `olive optimize` CLI command with a comprehensive pass scheduling system in olive/cli/optimize.py, integrating multiple performance optimization passes for various execution providers, precisions, and model input types.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Changes to launcher.py registered the subcommand; base.py added dry_run option; test files added extensive unit tests (later consolidated).
change_trajectory: Initial implementation of OptimizeCommand with pass scheduling.
Multiple iterative commits from maintainer to fix lint, pass configs, add block_size, modality, refactor, etc.
Agent responded to feature requests with new commits.
Final commits added tests and lint fixes; PR approved but not merged.

review_signals.summary: Requested --save_config_file option; Copilot responded it was already implemented.
Requested --block_size option for quantization block size.
Requested --modality option with wikitext2 data config for text.
Noted that QNN environment path was hardcoded; requested an optional argument.
Removed 'vision' from modality choices as it is not supported.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot removed vision and updated help text.

review_signals.summary: Requested adding optimize function to Python API and updating documentation.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot added Python API function and updated docs.

review_signals.summary: Asked to indicate which CLI is being tested in test function name.
Requested removal of duplicate test_optimize.py file.
Questioned why output_dir changed from tmp_path in test_quantize_command.
Approved after all requested changes were addressed.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened large PR with initial implementation of optimize command.
Maintainers added multiple feature requests and refactoring suggestions over several days.
Copilot responded with numerous commits adding requested features (block_size, modality, qnn_env_path, API, tests).
Intensive code review via inline comments, all addressed by agent.
Two maintainers approved; PR closed without merge, possibly due to remaining integration work or not yet production-ready.
